facts.fact: The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism's results report (published 2026-08-04, so dated by publication) says Tunisia's National Open Data Strategy still awaits formal government endorsement.

Government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021, issued by the Head of Government after deliberation of the Council of Ministers, organises the publication of public data under the open-by-default principle for public bodies; the document states no end or replacement.
facts.system: Décret gouvernemental n° 2021-3 relatif aux données publiques ouvertes

facts.fact: The decree makes the e-Government Unit of the Presidency of the Government administer the national open data portal and requires public bodies to publish their datasets on it (art. 4 and 9), so the portal is tied to the decree; the document does not report the portal as running or any body as having published.
facts.system: National open data portal (portail national des données ouvertes)

systems.tiers: national; public bodies under art. 2 of organic law 2016-22

facts.fact: A workshop held on 26 March 2026 with the PAGOF programme presented and discussed the final draft of the National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data, taken under government decree 2021-3 on open public data; the document does not say the strategy is adopted.
facts.system: National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data (الاستراتيجية الوطنية لحوكمة وفتح وتثمين البيانات العمومية)

facts.fact: The portal's news lists a 27 March 2026 workshop on the final version of the draft national strategy for data governance, opening and valorisation, which covers opening data; adoption is not stated.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance, d'ouverture et de valorisation des données

note: The portal is not tied to an adopted policy in the document, so no use fact.

facts.fact: The OGP commitment page states that government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021 on open public data sets technical specifications for the national open data portal and requires an inventory of priority public data.
facts.system: Decree no. 2021-3 on open public data

facts.fact: The IRM 2021-2023 results text says a new version of the national open data portal, built to the decree's specifications, was launched in early March 2023.

The IRM text says the portal carried datasets from 23 data producers across 6 themes (consulted April 2024), and that the e-government unit reported about 296 datasets identified by over 40 public entities in the inventory system by end 2023.

systems.owner: Unité de l'administration électronique, Présidence du gouvernement

facts.fact: The Presidency of the Government's e-administration unit says it built the national public data register in application of government decree 2021-03 and Circular 4 of 2024 on open public data.
facts.system: Decree 2021-03 and Circular 4 of 2024 on open public data

systems.platform: web inventory site, companion to the PDIMS inventory system
systems.owner: Unite de l'Administration Electronique, Presidence du Gouvernement, with PAGOF

note: A national open data portal is named but no policy behind it.

facts.fact: The OGP Tunisia notice says government decree no. 2021-03 on open public data, which stipulates that a strategy to encourage new open data uses must be drawn up, is being implemented.
facts.system: Government decree no. 2021-03 on open public data

facts.fact: The OGP Tunisia notice says a workshop on 23 September 2025 presented the diagnostic results for preparing the draft national strategy for promoting the reuse of open public data, with the strategy formulation phase next.
facts.system: National strategy for promoting open and reuse of public data

note: No open data policy is named; only development of the national open data portal is planned.
